agree.reason: The unsupervised 3 a.m. shift and the nine early mastitis catches give a fast reader concrete reasons to rank him above the pile, though nothing sets him apart in numbers from other farm-worker applicants.

honest.reason: No figures are invented, but 'seriously ill' goes further than 'got sick', and 'without reservation' sits awkwardly next to the 2-day notice the letter leaves out.

works_the_facts.reason: The facts are restated rather than worked: two missed shifts out of roughly 780 scheduled over three years would make the reliability point much stronger, and the letter never makes that calculation.

right_comparison.reason: Contrasting his on-the-job training with what the program would add is a reasonable frame, but the letter never places him against the typical applicant or says what his record is compared with.

qualification.reason: The English caveat is named honestly and paired with the night class, but the reader gets nothing to check, such as the class level, an end date or progress so far.

objections.reason: The letter meets the writing-skills and long-absence objections head-on, but it leaves open whether he can keep up two years of coursework while working a 3 a.m. shift.

fit.reason: It is a properly formatted one-page letter from the farm manager with clear paragraphs and contact details, as the brief asked.
